question: After three targeted measurement corrections — (1) V3 selection bias fixed via endpoint-stratified non-304 pooling, (2) V_ETAG_PERMISSION_LEAKAGE fixed by deriving permission_level from session independent of token expiry, (3) C5/C7 re-measured at n>=800 — does the frozen decision rule yield CONFIRMED (all C1-C7 pass) or REJECTED (any fails) at delta=0.15 on the production-like testbed?
hypothesis: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality at delta=0.15 will be CONFIRMED once three measurement defects are corrected. The parent's MIXED outcome (C5 FAIL, C7 FAIL) was contaminated by: (a) V3 selection bias — valid cache-enabled non-304 composition skewed 91% session_status (40/44 samples), inflating pooled r from true stratified ~0.04 to -0.126 and C5 heterogeneity diff from true non-304 ~0.25 to 0.466; (b) V_ETAG_PERMISSION_LEAKAGE — expired tokens default to read-etag, violating structural independence for write-permission conditions; (c) insufficient power for C5/C7 at n=480 (minimum detectable |r| ~0.09, but C5/C7 need higher power for heterogeneity/negative-control thresholds). With these corrected: audit-computed non-304 per-endpoint r values (0.009, 0.122, -0.013) and stratified pooled r ~0.04 indicate within-endpoint orthogonality is strong; B-FLASK-ONLY baseline (r=0.0263, TOST PASS) confirms infrastructure-independent orthogonality; n>=800 provides power for C5/C7 thresholds. The correct non-304 per-cache r (enabled ~-0.453) is biased by endpoint heterogeneity (session_status endpoint with high structural mean 0.57), not infrastructure coupling — endpoint-stratified weighting removes this artifact.
falsifier: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality is falsified at delta=0.15 if ANY of: (C1) behavioral detection TP < 0.85 across all endpoints; (C2) fewer than 2/3 endpoints have non-304 behavioral signal std > 0 AND fewer than 2/3 have non-304 structural signal std > 0; (C3) 95% CI upper bound of endpoint-stratified pooled Pearson r (non-304, stratified by endpoint) >= 0.15 on production-like testbed; (C4) TOST equivalence test p_upper >= 0.05 at delta=0.15 (one-sided, endpoint-stratified non-304); (C5) endpoint-stratified cache-mode heterogeneity check: |r_stratified_enabled - r_stratified_disabled| >= 2 * SE_pooled; (C6) B-FLASK-ONLY baseline shows |r| >= 0.15; (C7) B-PARENT-CONFOUND-REPRODUCTION shows |r| < 0.15 (negative control fails to reproduce V1 confound).

baselines.description: Prior localhost Flask mock orthogonality: pooled r=0.0022 delta=0.15 PASS (EXP-GRAPH-35389145821, n=480, audit PASS). Stochastic mock r=0.0463 delta=0.15 PASS (EXP-GRAPH-35353011131, n=480, audit PASS). Stochastic mock confirmation r=-0.0258 delta=0.15 PASS (EXP-PRODUCT-35434772331, n=480, audit PASS). HTTP caching confirmation r=0.0022 delta=0.15 PASS (EXP-GRAPH-35389145821, n=480, audit PASS).
baselines.expected: |r| < 0.15, consistent with four prior localhost confirmations

baselines.description: Plain Flask server WITHOUT CDN simulation, OAuth middleware, or dynamic content, but WITH genuine token-state variation (valid/expired tokens via Authorization header). Uses corrected headers-only structural signal extraction (ETag, Cache-Control, UUID-based request_id). Tests whether orthogonality persists without production-like infrastructure features.

Reproduction of parent V1 confound: request_id uses token_hex for expired responses and uuid4 for valid responses (the exact prior defect). Expected to show |r| >= 0.15 to confirm the confound is genuine. This is a negative control — a PASS here (|r| < 0.15) would indicate the V1 confound was not genuine or the fix is incomplete.
baselines.expected: |r| >= 0.15 (negative control confirming V1 was genuine confound)

positive_control: Token validation failure detection: behavioral signal must correctly identify expired vs valid tokens with TP >= 0.85. The testbed_server.py @require_token decorator returns 401 for expired tokens and the behavioral signal extractor detects status_code, X-Token-Validation header, and session_state_change. TP=1.0 was achieved in all prior experiments. If TP < 0.85, behavioral signal extraction is broken.
null_control: Structural signal std > 0 across all non-304 conditions: ETag, Cache-Control, and UUID-based dynamic content should produce non-zero structural variation even on cache-disabled responses (no-store/no-cache). Behavioral std should be zero only on conditions with no auth state variation (all-valid or all-expired). Both behavioral and structural signals should have std > 0 on the 8 co-occurring non-304 conditions.
measurement_validity: V3 FIX (SELECTION BIAS): Apply endpoint-stratified weighting for pooled Pearson r estimate. The valid cache-enabled non-304 composition is skewed (profile 2, data_list 2, session_status 40 valid), inflating pooled r. Stratified pooled r weights each endpoint's r by its n, removing endpoint-heterogeneity artifacts. Per-endpoint non-304 r values (audit: profile 0.009, data_list 0.122, session -0.013) suggest true pooled r ~0.04.

V_ETAG_PERMISSION_LEAKAGE FIX: In testbed_server.py _make_unauthorized_response(), derive permission_level from the session/endpoint context independent of token expiry. Pass permission_level explicitly as a parameter from the request handler before expiry check, so write-permission expired requests get write-etag (not fallback read-etag). Verify fix: valid and expired write-permission ETags should overlap (same stable_key = f'{path}_{permission_level}').
V1 FIX VERIFIED (from parent): ALL request_ids use uuid.uuid4() for all status codes. Entropy valid=3.723 vs expired=3.728, p=0.68 (no difference).
V2 FIX VERIFIED (from parent): B-FLASK-ONLY has genuine token-state variation via /token endpoint, behavioral_std=3.5 > 0, r=0.026 defined (not NaN).

304 EXCLUSION: Exclude 304 responses from pooled correlation, per-endpoint correlations, and per-cache correlations (C3, C4, C5, C6). 304 uses different structural composite construction (fixed 0.2 for dynamic_content_hash vs variable sha256 hash) and occurs exclusively for valid tokens (76 valid vs 0 expired in parent).

POWER INCREASE: n >= 800 paired samples from >= 3 endpoints x >= 2 cache modes x >= 2 auth states. Parent at n=480 had minimum detectable |r| ~0.09, insufficient for C5/C7 thresholds at n=480. At n>=800, SE ~0.035, minimum detectable |r| ~0.07.
TOST ONE-SIDED: C3 tests CI upper < 0.15 only; C4 tests TOST p_upper < 0.05 only (one-sided, consistent with frozen spec).
Testbed server must produce genuine behavioral AND structural stochastic variation
CDN simulation must implement genuine cache behavior: ETag-SHA256, Cache-Control max-age/no-store, 304 handling via If-None-Match
OAuth middleware must use real PyJWT RS256 validation

Structural signal extraction must use ONLY: (a) ETag change (0/1), (b) Cache-Control change (0/1), (c) normalized Shannon entropy of UUID-based request_id, (d) SHA256(request_id)[:16] as int % 10000 / 10000
Each endpoint must have independent behavioral and structural signal extraction — no shared variables between signal domains
decision_rule: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality at delta=0.15 is CONFIRMED if ALL of: (C1) behavioral detection TP >= 0.85 across all endpoints (expired tokens correctly detected as drift); (C2) at least 2/3 endpoints have non-304 behavioral signal std > 0 AND at least 2/3 endpoints have non-304 structural signal std > 0; (C3) 95% CI upper bound of endpoint-stratified pooled Pearson r (non-304 samples only) < 0.15 on production-like testbed; (C4) TOST equivalence test p_upper < 0.05 at delta=0.15 (one-sided, non-304 samples only); (C5) endpoint-stratified cache-mode heterogeneity check (non-304 samples): |r_stratified_enabled - r_stratified_disabled| < 2 * SE_pooled; (C6) B-FLASK-ONLY baseline shows |r| < 0.15; (C7) B-PARENT-CONFOUND-REPRODUCTION shows |r| >= 0.15 (negative control passes, confirming V1 was genuine). C-FRESHNESS orthogonality is REJECTED if ANY condition fails. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if infrastructure failure prevents data collection (endpoint unreachable, testbed construction fails, n < 400).
product_consequence_positive: C-FRESHNESS advances from EXPERIMENTAL toward VALIDATED on production-like infrastructure. Parallel-channel architecture (separate behavioral and structural signal processing) is justified for product deployment. Product may proceed with dual-signal freshness detection: behavioral signals for auth/session drift, structural signals for cache/schema drift.
product_consequence_negative: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality fails on production-like infrastructure even with corrected measurement, endpoint-stratified pooling, and increased power. Parallel-channel architecture is NOT justified. Product must pivot to fused classifiers or cache-independent structural signals. The localhost mock evidence is insufficient for production deployment.
estimated_cost: Low: (1) Fix V_ETAG_PERMISSION_LEAKAGE in testbed_server.py (~10 lines, ~15 min); (2) Apply endpoint-stratified weighting in run_experiment.py (~20 lines, ~20 min); (3) Increase n from 480 to 800 (~30-60 min execution); (4) Analysis (~1 hour). Total: 2-3 compute-hours.
expected_information_gain: Very high: this is the minimum cost experiment that directly resolves all three measurement validity gaps (V3 selection bias, V_ETAG_PERMISSION_LEAKAGE, C5/C7 power) blocking a clean CONFIRMED or REJECTED verdict for C-FRESHNESS on production-like infrastructure. The same testbed infrastructure is reused with three small targeted code fixes. Either outcome changes a product decision: CONFIRMED justifies parallel-channel architecture; REJECTED forces architectural pivot. A clean MEASUREMENT_INVALID verdict is also informative.
